technical.summary: NEE shows mixed technicals with strong trend structure (EMA cross, Ichimoku, SuperTrend) but momentum weakness (RSI 39, negative MACD histogram, weak CMF) and Bollinger Band squeeze limiting conviction—moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: NEE shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 52 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (26/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed with only junior-level small purchases and no senior conviction; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (308.0) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinationals, and earnings in 52 days adds event risk to utilities sector already facing rate/inflation pressures.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross, Ichimoku above cloud, and SuperTrend bullish establish structural uptrend with price near support (76.23), offering contrarian entry in extreme fear (VIX 308) with asymmetric risk/reward.
debate.key_bear_argument: Momentum collapse (RSI 39, MACD negative histogram, CMF weak), Bollinger Band squeeze with price below midline, macro crisis (inverted yield curve, strong dollar), earnings event risk in 52 days, and price below 50/200 EMAs undermine conviction despite technical structure.

decision.entry_rationale: EMA 9/21 golden cross with price at support (76.23) and Ichimoku above cloud provide structural uptrend confirmation; extreme market fear (VIX 308) creates contrarian opportunity in utilities sector.
decision.primary_risk: Momentum collapse (RSI 39, negative MACD histogram, weak CMF) combined with macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, strong dollar) and earnings event in 52 days creates high probability of false breakout or pullback before confirmation.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technicals show structure but momentum weakness; fundamentals and risk agents strongly bearish; sentiment offers contrarian signal but lacks conviction.
